newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends off, mkt awaits cut in mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends off, mkt awaits cut in mini-band.

text.p: The Brazilian real dropped 0.05 percent to close at 1.0582 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, as players awaited the next reduction in the real-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The current mini-band was set by the Central Bank on March 31 at 1.0570 to 1.0620 reais per dollar.
Some banks had expected a Central Bank move today, but now the market is looking for the scaling-down on Monday, dealers said.

Thursday's net dollar flows posted a $174.5 million deficit, contrary to previous expectations of a large surplus. Dealers said the real's fall on Friday was partly caused by Thursday's deficit. Nonetheless, trade was calm on Friday.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0639 per dollar, down 0.03 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended steady at 1.130 per greenback.
